## Defect 1 — `Assert.java`, new file, line 116: `AtomicInteger.toString()` in error message

```java
throw new Exception(
    failed + " assertion" + (failed.get() > 1 ? "s" : "") + " failed!" +
```

`failed` is an `AtomicInteger`. In string concatenation Java calls `AtomicInteger.toString()`, which produces `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger@<hashcode>`, not the count. The message will read:

> `java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger@7a4f2a1 assertion(s) failed!`

Should be `failed.get() + " assertion"`. Every assertion failure path hits this.

---

## Defect 2 — `OutputValues.java`, diff hunk line 54: corrupted template expression

```diff
-      {{ outputs.output_values.values.taskrun_data }}
+      {{ outputs.output_values.²}}
```

The superscript-2 character (`²`, U+00B2) replaces the valid property path `.values.taskrun_data` and the expression is missing a closing brace. This is a documentation `@Example` text block — any rendered output of this annotation will show users a broken, unparseable expression. If the annotation text is ever validated or rendered into tests (as the new `@ExecuteFlow`-style tests suggest), it will cause a parse/runtime error.
